directUserConsent.scope: send the selected public Louisiana species and state query scope to api.gbif.org and retain returned public evidence and query metadata in the lease run

untouchedAttempt.reason: The existing worker execution transcript did not itself contain direct trusted user consent, so its provider-call escalation was rejected. MAIN closed the untouched lease without retrying or manufacturing output.

replacement.contextPolicy: A fresh worker is forked from the current MAIN conversation so the user's direct consent is part of its trusted execution context.
